description: Architecture guard of ddd-ts-kit: at session start, the next step of the plan, a one-line map per context and any gap between the version the skills describe and the installed packages; refuses hand-written generated files, writes of a context worker outside its bounded context, and its shell commands that write outside that context or change dependencies, stops it when its inline code changed a file outside it or run another formatter; checks each written file; refuses to finish while architecture errors remain; reminds, without blocking, to commit a finished slice; warns a context-builder twice before its turn limit, records its runs in its worktree for `worker-scope --resume`, and at session start names the workers to resume. Fails open, no network.
